notify.title.message: Requests come through a proxy ReputeCast doesn't trust
notify.title.note: notification title for instance admins; a proxy is the reverse proxy or load balancer in front of ReputeCast

notify.body.message: {peer} forwards requests to ReputeCast with {header}, but {setting} doesn't list it. Every open and click looks like it comes from {peer}, so the bot filter can't see readers' addresses. Add {peer} to {setting} (environment variable {env}) and restart ReputeCast.
notify.body.note: {setting} and {env} are configuration names, never translated; {header} is an HTTP header name

advice.none: No request came through a proxy ReputeCast doesn't trust.

advice.some.message: Add these addresses to {setting} (environment variable {env}) and restart ReputeCast, so opens, clicks and rate limits see readers' own addresses.
advice.some.note: {setting} and {env} are configuration names, never translated
